correctness.rationale: For every unimodular three-point vector a Fourier zero forces an equilateral triple, hence a character: each shifted product has either one or three Fourier nonzeros. Two exceptional translations imply the window has cube-root successive ratios; normalization and a quadratic-chirp parametrization yield exactly 27 triple intersections. For nine tori, every cross-translation pair meets in three points and the same-translation sets are disjoint. Inclusion-exclusion gives 27, 9q²−81, q⁴−9q²+54 for every 3-divisible q; complete modular and independent direct-DFT enumerations at q=3,6,9,12 verify the finite boundary without replacing proof.
